# Built-in renderers

A projection's `renderer` names a renderer by one of its handles. Each built-in renderer is a sandboxed web page
built with the [renderer SDK](../../packages/renderers/sdk/README.md) and [kit](../../packages/renderers/kit/README.md), exactly as a
custom renderer is. Comparison modes are the ways it presents a comparison, in the order hosts offer them.

| Renderer | Handles | Comparison modes |
|---|---|---|
| [Agentic workflows](#agentic-workflows) | `agentic-workflows` | `diff`, `side-by-side` |
| [API](#api) | `api` | `diff`, `side-by-side` |
| [Code statistics](#code-statistics) | `code-statistics` | `diff`, `side-by-side`, `animated`, `swipe` |
| [Database](#database) | `database`, `schema` | `diff`, `side-by-side`, `animated`, `swipe` |
| [Dependency injection](#dependency-injection) | `dependency-injection` | `diff`, `side-by-side`, `animated`, `swipe` |
| [File packing](#file-packing) | `file-packing`, `treemap` | `diff`, `side-by-side`, `animated`, `swipe` |
| [Gallery](#gallery) | `gallery` | `diff`, `side-by-side`, `animated` |
| [Graph](#graph) | `graph`, `graph-horizontal`, `dag`, `architecture`, `infrastructure`, `dependencies` | `diff`, `side-by-side`, `animated`, `swipe` |
| [Runtime security policies](#runtime-policy) | `runtime-policy` | `diff`, `side-by-side` |
| [Text diff](#text-diff) | `text-diff` | `diff` |

## `agentic-workflows`

Built-in Projections agentic workflows renderer: each workflow's triggers, scope, outputs and budgets, and the direction each change moves them. See [its page](../builtins/renderers/agentic-workflows.md).

- Handles: `agentic-workflows`
- Comparison modes: `diff`, `side-by-side`
- Package: `@githubnext/projections-renderer-agentic-workflows`
- Example scenarios ([`scenarios.json`](../../packages/renderers/agentic-workflows/scenarios.json)): Widen a documentation bot and drop a guardrail; The same change as a matrix; Widen a public workflow's network; The same change, default comparator; Public workflows at a glance

## `api`

Built-in Projections API renderer: exported declarations with before and after signatures. See [its page](../builtins/renderers/api.md).

- Handles: `api`
- Comparison modes: `diff`, `side-by-side`
- Package: `@githubnext/projections-renderer-api`
- Example scenarios ([`scenarios.json`](../../packages/renderers/api/scenarios.json)): Payments library 2.0 (.NET); Rate limiter 2.0 (Rust); Ledger 2.0 (Go); Job queue 2.0 (TypeScript); HTTP client 2.0; Parser options; HTTP client surface

## `code-statistics`

Built-in Projections code-statistics renderer: per-language counts as bars or share, staged by the comparison's steps. See [its page](../builtins/renderers/code-statistics.md).

- Handles: `code-statistics`
- Comparison modes: `diff`, `side-by-side`, `animated`, `swipe`
- Package: `@githubnext/projections-renderer-code-statistics`
- Example scenarios ([`scenarios.json`](../../packages/renderers/code-statistics/scenarios.json)): Gateway: JavaScript to TypeScript; Gateway: Rust first (custom order); Languages: arrival and departure; Languages: Python first (custom order); Methods per access scope; Gateway: one revision
